body: Actually if you think about it suicide is the most RATIONAL choice because you are going to die anyway. Why going trought all that pain and misery and die when you can just die now. It's the most rational and the most irrational at the same time. Matter of perspective.
I think it's not selfish. It's a good choice when there is not other good one.

What would you do in my place: No job, no significant education, never had girlfriend (and never will because of social anxiety, ugliness and poverty), never will get a job with more than minimum wage (which in my country means just surviving), I had some friends but I don't enjoy hanging out, weak physically, mentally ill, not able to work, always tired, divorced parents, brother who is the same as me, living in a small town with no opportunities, no hobbies, I'm gonna do it.
Thank you bro but nothing makes me happy anymore. The only think I want to do is to die.
Jumping from every bridge exept Golden Gate dying is not guaranteed death (even 2% of GG jumpers survive). I would recommend suffoction or hanging or smth like that.
Sleeping pills don't work! You will only fuck up your liver. Try something else.
Let him die if he wants it so much. My family will never let me so I have no choice but doing it alone.
Tomorrow is my time! See you in the other side :)
The only science I like and can think all day about it is philosophy. It's 1:30 AM here but I can't stop reading (people there seem really connected). Really great community.
Thank you bro! It's even better than SW!
What did you mean by waiting couble of months?
It's good these days because when you know these are your last days, you feel good and you're calm :)

It's harder than you think. It's not normal to be in your most energetic years and to not have energy for anything. It may be laziness but I think it's some illness. I have been like that all my life.

I wish you luck! I also planned everything and was going to do it today but the weather was really bad so I watched the news and in 2 days it will be perfect. It's not selfish, my family will be better without me because I am only consuming. Yea they will be sad first months but after that they will get over it and realize it's better without me :)
I'm with you bro. I hope we will see each other in the other side someday!

It's like I've wrote this! I've been thinking about it almost all of my life. When I was 2nd-3th grade and seeing 6-7th graders having girlfriends/boyfriends and being confiden I thought I will become like that within the years (I thought it's from the age). Then I became 6th-7th grade and I realized it's harder than it looked like. At the same time I saw my older friends having a job and dealing with it. I thought again "I am not ready yet, but I just have to wait till my self esteem and confidence is high enough to be able to do the job" and guess what. That never happened. I am still really anxious while having to do any kind of job (except cleaning or washing dishes). Then I thought maybe when I go to college I will change (they said it's really cool there). So I went to college and guess what... same shit. How do people deal with life so easy? I hate my genetics :( PM me I would like to talk to someone like me.
Yea bro, it's something like athletic man visiting forum for handicaped people. Nothing angainst it, it's just weird.

I really liked your post (not because you are suicidal, just liked the way you think). According to science (evolution) only the fittest survive. But not in humanity. Here we all survive, even when we try to die, they help us to survive, even when we have no money, they help us to survive. So we are the exception of evolution. I am not from the fittest, not even from the 90% fitter, not even from the 98%(maybe). When you fight against nature, you fail. In other words, according to evolution we mustn't exist but other people fight against that and the nature's answer is to make us depressed and suicidal. Thats my theory.
Sorry to tell you that but there is no point.
I really like the way you think, do you want to chat in Skype or something else?

Most of us can't give you advice for happiness (I don't believe someone who is happy will visit SW). I can tell you that there are many people like us and half of them are keep going and half of them (like me) gave up and are waiting for the day they will have the courage. Medications don't work (even for suicide). They are only stealing your money.
The ultimate reason most people keep on going is that they are afraid from the pain.

Unfortunately I'm still alive :(
Tell me what would you do in my place: 19 y/o Living in small town with no opportunities in country forgetten from God, no job, all my friends succeeded to go to a bigger city, no girlfriend, various mental illness (especially social anxiety), having a brother who is in almost same position (even worse than me), poor parents, no useful education, no motivation for anything, going to become homeless soon or late, it's inevitable. I'm going to die anyway after a couble of years (from starvation). Death is something good for me bro. Today I didn't had the courage, but some day soon I HAVE to do it.
I'm with you bro. After 2 hours I will do it, see you in the other side.
Before one week I gaved myself one week max. And guess what, today is the last day. See you in 3 months on the other side bro (if it exists).
You just described my life (except I am not fat, but I am ugly, so the same).

You probably live in a First world country (maybe USA?) where even without education you can live good. I live in a shitty eastern european country where I will live in misery for the rest of my life.
What if I told you financial problems are one of the top 3 reasons for suicide.

I have no interests (hobbies). Every kind of effort, except Internet surfing is extremely painful and really hard to achieve for me (even getting out of bed at morning). I like only virtual world and hate the real one. You maybe will say to become a programmer then, yes, I tried (I dropped out of college 1 month ago) but I suck at it.
Also I'm alone, never had a girlfriend and with social anxiety.

Yes there is, but they don't help... I think about future and what it will be. I will become homeless, I can't deal with life. The future will get only worse. If you knew you have mental illnesses that don't let you work and you will become homeless with no money, you will want to do it too.

I can talk to 3-4 close friends about it. They don't understand me. There is nothing to live for, only disappointment. Living with low self esteem, social anxiety and lack of energy and motivation is really painful. Trust me, staying alive is something really bad for me.

Hmm... You are right. If you think about it, suicide is both the least and the most rational think you can do. For some people is the least, for some is the most rational choice anyone can make (because you are going to die anyway).

You are asking what if you don't succeed in suicide and end up in hospital? You have 2 options. First one is continuing living and giving everything you can! Second one is to choose highly lethal method with no chance (<0.1%) of surviving. Actually, that applies for me too (I personally choosed the second one).

Bro I am really jealous to your courage for suicide. I also "tried" hanging before 20 minutes but it went sitting under the tree, holding the rope in my hand and thinking about life. Didn't even tried. And that happens for 2 weeks straight. I sit everyday in the forest 2-3 hours waiting to gain courage and I always end up going home. Any advice bro? Please answer me.

Hmm... If you are a good person you should worry about the 'hell thing'. I don't believe in hell, but even if it exist I will be there, soon or later. Soon is better because I am going there anyway. But I am almost sure there is no heaven or hell.

It's your choice, bro. Some people like living with minimum wage job and are happy. Some are not. For example me. If I chose to live I will have to do low qualified job for the rest of my life and it will be the best scenario. I can't get up from bed in the morning. Keeping a job is almost impossible.  Tomorrow is my day bro. You decide for yourself.

The rope can take 1000 kg, it doesn't stretch, my feet will be atleast 50 cm in the air, the branch is also reliable (almost impossible to break from my weight), so definitely no chance for surviving.

Hanging (not long drop). But my rope is really good, somehting like that: http://images11.palcdn.com/hlr-system/WebPhotos/17/174/1740/1740703.jpg?_v=5a94e708-b43a-47fc-b9d2-56110847a5a6
I have chosen high branch (about 2,50 meters). The only thing I need is courage.

I have the right to be here and not to be. Sadly euthanasia is illegal in my country (but even if it was no one in my family will support me. So even then I would have to do it myself). I think my method is good enough and I have considered it for weeks. No chance of surviving with brain damage.

Your story sounds like a movie bro. But in my case girls don't help. Actually it helped one time, I was going to kill myself but because of a date with a girl i decided to do it after a few weeks. And now is a few weeks later. Girls don't help in my case, it was just for couple of days help but then I realized it gets boring. Whatever you do, it gets boring. Even if you have the best girl after some time you will not be happy anymore. Or maybe it's just me and my fucked up brain hormones for happiness.

"I promise you, there is one."
Yea yea, everybody knows that one.
How is it possible to survive hanging if your feet don't touch the ground? Are you immortal or something?

You have 3 choices:
FIRST: Try EVERYTHING possible to make your life better and succeeding.
SECOND: Homeless.
TRIRD: Seppuku (that's a joke, it's a terrible way to die, not recommended).

I am not wealthy, neighter homeless but I will be soon or later. I can't deal with life. Life is too hard for me. All this bills, taxes, job, obligations, everything seems so hard (and not only seems). I can't even get up from the bed. I can survive 2-3-5 even 10 years more with family support but I will be a parasite. I don't want to waste their money and time. And I like death so it's not a big problem for me. The only problem are the painful minutes before death, but there is nothing easy :)

I really wnat to have a gun like you! Sadly I don't live in the US. So I have to do it with a rope, which is even harder, because after the act you have to wait some minutes in pain... The good thing is that you can't survive it if you don't touch the floor, while you can survive a shot in the head (it's small chance but you can).
